memories.content: Each member has their own schedule, priorities, and level of engagement with the draft revision. Some may be more diligent about returning ballots, others may be less so. No member has a known commitment to return the ballot by the deadline.

The Interchange Format Working Group has 21 members. Draft revision 4 has been circulated for ballot. The comment period closes at the hard cutoff: 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Ballots are returned individually by members. The group has no formal enforcement mechanism for ballot return.
